items.headline: Shanahan says 49ers WR Deebo Samuel to miss time with hamstring injury
items.description: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel is expected to miss "at least a couple of weeks" with the hamstring injury he suffered Sunday in Seattle, coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday.

items.headline: 49ers' Dre Greenlaw suspended one game for head-butting helmetless Seahawks LB
items.description: 49ers linebacker Dre Greenlaw has been suspended for one game without pay for unsportsmanlike conduct during Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
